payload.name: Binary Judgments and Measured Numbers
payload.description: Judgments are yes or no confirmed by repetition; every stored number is a measured count with provenance or is absent. Covers confidence, importance, hotness, scores and reported figures.

principles.name: A model's self-score is not evidence
principles.description: Repeated binary confirmation is evidence; a 0.0 to 1.0 number the model made up about itself is not.

principles.name: Absence is honest
principles.description: A value nobody measured is stored as absent, never as a default that looks like a measurement.

heuristics.condition: a threshold such as 'score at least 0.7' appears in code or a prompt
heuristics.action: replace it with a yes or no judgment confirmed by votes or with a count of observed events

heuristics.condition: a hotness or importance literal sits in a builder next to real logic
heuristics.action: replace the literal with a value derived from observed use, or remove it

decision_rules.name: Judge by yes or no
decision_rules.condition: a decision needs a model's judgment (keep, drop, relevant, applicable, safe)
decision_rules.outcome: ask a yes or no question and confirm it through the configured strength-N consecutive votes; do not ask for or store a confidence, importance or probability

decision_rules.name: Weigh by class, not by score
decision_rules.condition: a relationship, edge or result needs a weight or rank
decision_rules.outcome: derive it from the relationship class, from verification, or from counts of observed events; a relationship an affirmed judgment found is present, otherwise absent

decision_rules.name: Store only measured numbers
decision_rules.condition: a number is about to be written to a container, ledger, report or document
decision_rules.outcome: write it only if a non-model source measured it and record where it came from; if nothing measured it write absent (None, false or no field), never an invented default

decision_rules.name: Remove, do not default
decision_rules.condition: a missing confidence or score is reported as a defect
decision_rules.outcome: remove the field and its readers instead of supplying a default value such as 0.5

decision_rules.name: Label derived figures
decision_rules.condition: a figure in a report is computed or counted from other figures rather than measured on the real system
decision_rules.outcome: state in the report that it is derived and from what, so a derived count is not read as a measurement
